name: scanner-missing-binary
description: A mandatory external scanner (e.g. `pip-audit`) was SKIPPED because the binary was missing (ENOENT). Under the default policy (blockOnSkippedCheck on) this is a recorded blocking reason but degrades to INCOMPLETE coverage — it must NEVER flip to PASS. This is the labeled reduced-coverage case: the verdict is INCOMPLETE, exit 2, and the reason is recorded verbatim.

notes: pip-audit binary not found; install it to enable Python dependency scanning. This is not a pass.
